name: Benzodiazepines and sedatives
description: Benzodiazepines, Z-drugs, barbiturates, and other sedatives: how they work, dependence and withdrawal, overdose with opioids, and safe tapering.
intro: Sedatives slow the brain. Benzodiazepines, Z-drug sleep medicines, barbiturates, and muscle relaxants such as carisoprodol mostly enhance GABA, the brain's main calming chemical. Suvorexant works differently, by blocking the wake-promoting chemical orexin.

blocks.p: Most medicines in this cluster are Schedule IV. They work well short-term but can cause physical dependence within weeks, and stopping suddenly after regular use can cause seizures. Tapers should be gradual and supervised.

boxed.title: Class-wide FDA boxed warning for benzodiazepines (2020)
items: Taking benzodiazepines with opioids can cause profound sedation, slowed breathing, coma, and death.
Benzodiazepines can be misused and can lead to addiction.
Regular use can cause physical dependence, and stopping suddenly can cause life-threatening withdrawal, including seizures.
